_help: Built-in edit presets (read-only; regenerated by scripts/build_presets.ts). Adapted from One Node · FLUX.2 [klein] Discover prompts (github.com/yanokusnir-ai/one-node-flux-2-klein) to Darkroom's preset rules, with separate Klein and Qwen-Image 2.1 wording. Your own presets live in data/user_presets.json and are merged by label.

presets.label: Sketch to render
presets.klein: Turn this flat technical sketch into a photorealistic product render of the [GARMENT], front view, on a plain light-grey background with soft studio light. Keep the exact silhouette, seams, panels, pockets, zips and trims from the sketch. Material: [MATERIAL].
presets.qwen: Turn the flat sketch in <image1> into a photorealistic product render of the [GARMENT], front view, on a plain light-grey background with soft studio light. Keep the silhouette, seams, panels, pockets, zips and trims of <image1> unchanged. Material: [MATERIAL].

presets.label: Fabric swap
presets.klein: Change the fabric of the garment to [FABRIC], with its real weight, drape, sheen and surface texture. Keep the cut, the seams, the colour, the pose, the lighting and the background identical.
presets.qwen: Change the fabric of the garment in <image1> to [FABRIC], with its real weight, drape, sheen and texture. Keep the cut, seams, colour, pose, lighting and background unchanged.

presets.label: Print placement
presets.klein: Using image 1 as the garment and image 2 as the print: apply the print from image 2 as an all-over pattern on the [PANEL], following the folds, seams and perspective of the fabric. Keep the garment shape, the other panels, the lighting and the background of image 1 identical.
presets.qwen: Apply the print from <image2> as an all-over pattern on the [PANEL] of the garment in <image1>, following its folds, seams and perspective. Keep the garment shape, the other panels, the lighting and the background of <image1> unchanged.

presets.label: Colourway
presets.klein: Recolour the garment as the colourway [COLOURS]. Keep the cut, the fabric texture, the stitching, the pose, the lighting and the background identical.
presets.qwen: Recolour the garment in <image1> as the colourway [COLOURS]. Keep the cut, fabric texture, stitching, pose, lighting and background unchanged.

presets.qwen: Show the garment in <image1> as a presentation sheet: front, back and side views in a row at the same scale, plain light-grey background, even light. Keep every detail, colour and material of <image1> unchanged in each view.
